{{Quote|Would you say this little slavery ring of your falls under regulations, Colonel? Perhaps not?|A protocol officer|<ref name="Heroes & Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>}}
'''Protocol officers''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau's]] [[Internal Affairs/Legends|Internal Affairs]] branch. Their mandate was to root out those inside the Empire that were planning to undermine it for either personal or idealogical reasons. Despite having no official jurisdiction inside the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], protocol officers were often assigned to military units where there were suspected traitors. When identified, the protocol officers made an example of the offender. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Vella Derwayne]] served the Empire as a protocol officer.
